title: Crispy Vietnamese Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry made with lovely, crispy, Vietnamese noodles, tofu, and a variety of vegetables.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm, drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: Crispy Vegetables
ingredients.notes: Bok choy, bean sprouts, and carrots, chopped

instructions: Cook the noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the crispy vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked noodles and soy sauce, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until everything is well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
